description: Land Acquisition - Pelgahathenna, Passara D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition for public purpose under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired, including location, extent, and claimant information. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
